Rates are \emph{trial-level}: a run is a false alarm if at least one safe probe was declared an overshoot, and a miss if at least one overshooting probe was accepted. Trial-level is the correct unit because probes within a run are dependent; the probe-level counts are supporting telemetry only. Reverse engineering and brute force have no detector and are omitted rather than scored as zero. Reverse engineering's $N_{\mathrm{guess}}$ and the safeguard's correction to $N_*$ are instead evaluated in Tables~\ref{tab:diag-exploration} and \ref{tab:diag-downstream}.
